free_tier.stated: No published byte cap on the curated path; ICPSR states 'Anyone can deposit data into ICPSR's Consortium Archive at no cost' and covers curation from membership fees. Size is negotiated per study rather than metered.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: Free to users at member institutions; fee-gated for non-members unless the depositor buys five years of open access. That asymmetry is why this ranks below openICPSR.

tooling: Deposit via ICPSR's submission pipeline and the openICPSR front end; DOIs via DataCite; long-term preservation with redundant backups and format migration. No S3/WebDAV surface.
chaining: Unlimited studies per depositor, each negotiated for size; curation is the throttle, not quota.
limits_note: Human curation gate before release (weeks to months), plus the read-side membership paywall. Not self-service and not usable as working storage.

identity_cost.detail: inferred from the category 'academic'; the source record states no identity cost, so this is a class assumption, not evidence
